purpose: Raise a buried melody by one octave only when its whole-song median register is too close to the harmony register.
safetyRules: Use only candidate roles, counts, and MIDI medians at inference.
Never inspect the title, song identity, desired MIDI, or alignment at inference.
Abstain when either role has fewer than 200 events.
Abstain when melody already sits more than seven semitones above harmony.
Move melody only; preserve onsets, durations, velocities, pitch classes, and accompaniment.
Reject exact onset/key collisions and preserve the A1-C8 output range.

blindListeningEvidence.promotionVerifierInterpretation: The listening gate passed. Production promotion remains intentionally blocked because Kiss Me is development evidence rather than a new untouched holdout; the freeze receipt also preserves a one-character clerical runtime-hash mismatch instead of rewriting pre-reveal evidence.

freshHoldoutEvidence.rootCause: The narrow-gap rule octave-shifted 301 melody-role events even though all 301 were piano-derived. Candidate role geometry alone could not distinguish a buried lead from an already-authored piano line.
freshHoldoutEvidence.outcome: V002 rejected. Its earlier blind-listening win remains valid development evidence but does not override the fresh holdout failure.

rejectedAblations: Per-note logistic, random-forest, extra-trees, and histogram octave routers: complete-song transfer regressed badly.
Unconditional plus-one-octave melody shifting: unsafe for songs whose melody already has adequate separation.
Lower-confidence chord additions and dual-model score ensembles: they improved averages but regressed at least one whole song.
